Let's get you studying.

The desktop app adds the local tutor and AI quizzes. The atlas and Cell Studio already work in your browser, without installing anything.

Why you might see a warning

Soma Desktop is an unsigned preview. Windows may show Publisher: Unknown, and your browser may say it isn't commonly downloaded. We have not purchased publisher signing. A reputation warning is not a malware diagnosis, and it is not proof that a file is safe.

This guide explains your choices. Continue only if you trust this project and have checked the download source. You can cancel at any point.

Guide checked September 28, 2026. Wording varies with browser version, language, and school policies.
